resources.string: The email couldn\'t be prepared. Try again.
This recording has no transcript yet.
No mail app is available on this tablet.
Enter an email address, like name@company.com.
Your mail app opens with the email ready to send to this address. Nothing is sent until you tap Send there. You can change it in Settings › Storage, sync & backup.

For a work computer that can\'t open Google. Tap Email to work in a note\'s three-dot menu in the library, in the editor\'s More menu or in a recording\'s menu: your mail app opens with the text in the email and the notes attached as PDF and Word files. Nothing is sent until you tap Send.
